name: Smeargle

attacks.name: Splatter Coating
attacks.text: Change the type of a random Energy attached to your opponent’s Active Pokémon to 1 of the following at random: {Grass}, {Fire}, {Water}, {Lightning}, {Psychic}, {Fighting}, {Darkness}, or {Metal}.
